pricingSummary.overallAssessment: Sam's Club offers competitive pricing on the majority of bulk ingredients needed for wedding catering. Key advantages include chicken breast ($2.48/lb), pork loin ($1.98/lb), ahi tuna ($8.98/lb), and vanilla ice cream ($1.40/lb). Costco has slight advantages on ground beef, ribeye, and butter. WinCo tends to be slightly more expensive than both warehouse clubs for most items but offers smaller quantities.
